files.document_title: T15 Reliability Project proposed route, Dominion Energy, January 2024
files.what_it_shows: A simplified route map with the proposed pipeline as a red line from the Dan River area west of Ruffin Compressor Station, east through Rockingham and Caswell County area and then to Person County near Hyco Lake, ending north of Leesburg Road. Rendered as T15_proposed_route_p1.png.
Rendered page at 150 dpi. Route is drawn over a simplified road map without a scale bar.

searched: The attached Dominion proposed route PDF from the oilandgaswatch record.

The North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality T-15 project page. It lists permits, the 401 water quality application and erosion control plans, but links no route map. The 401 application and hearing officer report sit in the department's document system and were not opened, because the attached map already meets the test.
The Virginia Line label is the state line.
notes: The map is a simplified road map with no scale, so it supports only a loose georeference. The route has many named road shields and the compressor station and lake, so a georeferencer can fit it. The route also has a short northward spur at the east end near Hyco Lake. The department page and the permit application documents (401 application for project 20250069) may hold detailed figures if a better map is needed.
